title: Driving on defiles, canyons or mountain highways
subject: driver

required_observations.note: the right-hand edge of the highway
the subject's lateral position relative to that edge
the canyon or mountain road geometry
'under control' is operationalized from speed and the road geometry
control on a blind mountain road is operationalized against sight distance

activation_conditions: the subject drives a motor vehicle
the road is a defile, canyon or mountain highway

timing_requirements.requirement: the duty holds for the whole time the subject is on such a highway

residue: 'defiles or canyons or mountain highways' is a legal/geographic class, not an atom: it is a reading assumption declared per map or per trace
'under control' and 'as reasonably possible' are judgement standards needing an operationalization claim (a lateral offset bound and a speed/sight-distance model)

title: Obedience to signal indicating approach of railroad train or other on-track equipment (1)
subject: driver

required_observations.note: the crossing and its nearest track
lights flashing, gate lowering or down, bell sounding
role railroad_flagger and the signal given
(d) 'an approaching train is plainly visible': the train in the subject's line of sight
(c) its audible signal within about 1,500 feet
(c),(d) its distance from the crossing, and the subject's 50-and-15-foot band
(c) its speed, for the immediate-hazard test
operationalizes 'hazardous proximity' and 'until the driver can do so safely'

activation_conditions: the subject approaches a railroad grade crossing

a clearly visible device or a flagger warns of the immediate approach of a train, or a train within about 1,500 feet sounds an audible signal and is an immediate hazard, or an approaching train is plainly visible and in hazardous proximity

timing_requirements.requirement: the halt must be inside the band 15 to 50 feet from the nearest track, before the crossing
the subject may not proceed until it can do so safely — the halt persists while the warning continues
the trace must cover the warning and the release for the rule to decide

residue: 'immediate hazard' and 'hazardous proximity' are judgement elements
the audible-signal trigger needs audio, or that branch reports unknown
'a clearly visible … device' is the device's conspicuity, an equipment property; what a source sees is the device's state

title: Obedience to signal indicating approach of railroad train or other on-track equipment (2)
subject: driver

required_observations.note: gate ∈ {down, lowering, raising} — closed, being opened or being closed
the subject's footprint at the gate line
a path through, around or under the gate

activation_conditions: a crossing gate or barrier is closed, being opened or being closed
the subject drives through, around or under it

timing_requirements.requirement: the violation is the passage of the gate line while the gate is in any of the three states
the gate state must be tracked: passing after the gate is fully up is not this offence

title: Certain vehicles required to stop at all railroad grade (6)
subject: driver

required_observations.note: the crossing and its nearest rail
whether the track is clear — another user or object on the crossing
the distance from the nearest rail
operationalizes 'until the driver can do so safely'
a queue ahead that leaves the crossing occupied

activation_conditions: the subject approaches a railroad crossing
the track or tracks are not clear

timing_requirements.requirement: the stop precedes the crossing, inside the 15-to-50-foot band
the subject may not proceed until it can do so safely — the track must become clear first

residue: 'not clear' covers anything occupying the crossing, including a queue the subject would join; 'safely' is a judgement element

title: Circumstances in which driver or operator of slow-moving vehicle has duty to turn off roadway (1)
subject: driver

required_observations.note: the statutory definition of a slow-moving vehicle: below the posted limit
five or more vehicles formed in a line behind the subject
traffic in the opposite direction that makes passing unsafe
the designated turnout, or a place where a safe turnout exists
code turnout_ahead — the signs erected by the public authority

activation_conditions: the highway has one lane in each direction
passing is unsafe because of oncoming traffic or other conditions
the subject is a slow-moving vehicle as the section defines it
five or more vehicles are formed in a line behind it
exceptions: where no designated turnout and no place with sufficient area and safe circumstances exists

timing_requirements.requirement: the queue of five must persist long enough to be a line rather than a momentary cluster; the persistence bound must be declared
the duty is discharged at the nearest turnout after the queue forms — so the queue's formation and the next turnout must both be in the trace
a clip shorter than the distance to the next turnout cannot decide the rule

residue: 'sufficient area for a safe turnout' and 'able to turn off in a safe manner' are judgement elements

title: “Low-speed vehicle” defined (2)(b)
subject: low_speed_vehicle_operator

required_observations.note: the posted limit for the highway, against 35 mph and the 45 mph variant
the portion of highway it applies to
the exception: crossing such a highway at an intersection
body and markings, from which the class is read

activation_conditions: the subject operates a low-speed vehicle
the posted speed limit of the highway is greater than 35 miles per hour
exceptions: crossing such a highway at an intersection
a registered neighborhood occupantless vehicle may operate where the posted limit is greater than 35 but not more than 45 miles per hour
the further exception the section's subsection 3 gives

timing_requirements.requirement: judged at every instant the vehicle is on the highway
the crossing exception lasts only for the crossing manoeuvre

residue: registration of a neighborhood occupantless vehicle is an administrative fact; occupancy is the observable that distinguishes the sub-class

title: Driving through funeral or other procession (1)
subject: driver

required_observations.note: the vehicles displaying pennants or authorized insignia
the procession moving as a line
the subject inserting itself between two members
the subject's position in the line
the exception: a police officer directing

activation_conditions: a funeral or other authorized procession is in motion
its vehicles are properly identified by pennants or other authorized insignia
the subject drives between its members
exceptions: when otherwise directed by a police officer
when directed by the driver of a vehicle escorting the funeral procession

timing_requirements.requirement: the violation is the insertion between two members while the procession moves
the procession must be in motion at that time

residue: whether a procession is 'authorized' is an administrative fact; the pennants or insignia are the observable

title: Driving in procession (1)
subject: procession_vehicle

required_observations.note: the vehicles ahead in the procession
the headway, which operationalizes 'as closely as practicable and safe'
the speed at which the gap is judged

activation_conditions: the subject is a vehicle, person or animal comprising a funeral or other procession
a member precedes it

timing_requirements.requirement: the gap is judged throughout the procession's movement

residue: tier S: 'as closely as practicable and safe' is a two-sided standard — the rule must bound the gap both ways, and both bounds are a surrogate

title: Driving in procession (2)
subject: procession_vehicle

required_observations.note: its membership, from the pennants or insignia
the procession line it is part of

activation_conditions: the subject is a vehicle in a funeral procession

timing_requirements.requirement: the headlamps must be lighted for the whole time the vehicle is in the procession, by day as well as by night

residue: membership of a procession is read from the pennants or insignia; without them the activation is unknown

title: Personal delivery device (2)(a)
subject: delivery_device_operator

required_observations.note: the highway it may not operate on
the device's footprint on the highway
the exception: crossing at an intersection
the pedestrian way the device belongs on

activation_conditions: a personal delivery device is operating
its footprint is on a highway

timing_requirements.requirement: judged at every instant on the highway
the crossing exception lasts only for the crossing; lingering in the roadway is not covered

title: Personal delivery device (2)(b)
subject: delivery_device_operator

required_observations.note: the signals a pedestrian must obey
or the traffic signal governing the crossing
the crossing the device is using
the device's movement against the indication

activation_conditions: a personal delivery device is at a crossing governed by a traffic-control signal or device that binds pedestrians

timing_requirements.requirement: entry against the indication is the violation
the indication must be tracked for the whole crossing, as for a pedestrian

residue: the duty is defined by reference to the pedestrian signal rules — rule composition

title: Personal delivery device (2)(c)
subject: delivery_device_operator

required_observations.note: a pedestrian forced to divert or stop

activation_conditions: a personal delivery device is operating where pedestrians or vehicles are present

timing_requirements.requirement: judged whenever the device shares space with pedestrians or traffic
the other user's reaction must follow the device's movement

residue: tier S: 'unreasonably interfere' is the whole obligation; the bounds are a surrogate

title: Mobile carrying device (2)(a)
subject: delivery_device_operator

required_observations.note: the highway it may not operate on
the only exception: crossing within a crosswalk
the pedestrian way the device belongs on

activation_conditions: a mobile carrying device is operating
its footprint is on a highway
exceptions: when crossing within a crosswalk — narrower than the personal delivery device rule, which also allows crossing at an intersection

timing_requirements.requirement: judged at every instant on the highway
the crossing exception lasts only for the crossing

title: Mobile carrying device (2)(b)
subject: delivery_device_operator

required_observations.note: the signals a pedestrian must obey
or the traffic signal governing the crossing
the device's movement against the indication

activation_conditions: a mobile carrying device is at a crossing governed by a signal or device that binds pedestrians

timing_requirements.requirement: entry against the indication is the violation
the indication is tracked for the whole crossing

residue: rule composition with the pedestrian signal rules

title: Mobile carrying device (2)(c)
subject: delivery_device_operator
activation_conditions: a mobile carrying device is operating where pedestrians or vehicles are present

timing_requirements.requirement: judged whenever the device shares space with pedestrians or traffic

residue: tier S: 'unreasonably interfere' is the whole obligation; the bounds are a surrogate

title: Unlawful passing (4)
subject: moped_rider

required_observations.note: two or more clearly marked lanes in the subject's direction
the quarter-mile within which the left-turn lane may be entered
the move out of the right lane
(b) conditions that make the right lane unsafe

activation_conditions: the subject drives a moped
the highway has two or more clearly marked lanes in the subject's direction
exceptions: preparing to turn left, which allows entering the turn lane not more than a quarter of a mile before the turn
where driving in the extreme right lane would not be safe
in compliance with the directions of a police officer
a police officer in the performance of duty

timing_requirements.requirement: the left-turn preparation may begin at most a quarter of a mile before the turn — an upper bound on how early the lane may be left
the trace must cover that quarter mile for the exception to be checkable
otherwise the right lane must be held throughout

residue: 'would not be safe' is a judgement element

title: Following (A)
subject: driver

required_observations.note: the headway, which operationalizes 'reasonable and prudent'
the lead vehicle's braking, against which the gap is tested

activation_conditions: the subject follows another vehicle on a street
exceptions: funeral processions are outside this section

timing_requirements.requirement: a momentary closure is not the offence: the headway must stay below the bound for a declared interval
judged while the following relation holds

residue: tier S: 'reasonable and prudent' is the whole standard; the headway bound is a surrogate

title: Passing animals
subject: driver

required_observations.note: the vehicle drawn by a horse
the speed, which must be reduced if the horse appears frightened
the rider's or driver's signal requesting it
the horse's own movement, from which fright is read
a sound that would frighten the animal
the exception: a movement necessary to avoid accident or injury

activation_conditions: the subject drives a motor vehicle on a public street
it approaches a horse-drawn vehicle or a ridden horse
exceptions: a movement necessary to avoid accident or injury
once the animal appears to be under the control of its driver or rider

timing_requirements.requirement: the speed reduction follows the appearance of fright; the halt follows the rider's request
the subject may not proceed toward the animal until it appears to be under control
the precautions are owed throughout the approach

residue: tier S: 'every reasonable precaution' is the whole obligation
whether a horse 'appears frightened' or 'under control' is an inference from its motion, not an atom

title: Wheeled toys on streets and sidewalks (A)
subject: rider

required_observations.note: a coaster, roller skates, scooter, skateboard, toy vehicle or similar device
the person riding or using it
the exception: crossing a street at a crosswalk
the rights and duties the device then takes on
how it is treated while crossing

activation_conditions: a person rides or uses a coaster, roller skates, scooter, skateboard, toy vehicle or similar device
the device is on a roadway
exceptions: while crossing a street at a crosswalk, where the device takes on all the rights and duties of a pedestrian

timing_requirements.requirement: judged at every instant on the roadway
the crossing exception lasts only for the crossing

residue: while crossing, the pedestrian rules govern instead: rule composition, not a separate reading

title: Wheeled toys on streets and sidewalks (B)
subject: rider

required_observations.note: the person riding or using it
code nonmotorized_prohibited — the posted signs the rule requires
the stretch of sidewalk they control
the high volume of pedestrian traffic the ban answers

activation_conditions: the sidewalk is one of the posted Fremont Street stretches
the subject rides or uses such a device on it

timing_requirements.requirement: judged at every instant on the posted sidewalk

residue: the stretch 'between Main Street and Seventh Street' is a named geographic extent: a reading assumption per map, though the rule also requires posted signs, which are the observable

title: Wheeled toys on streets and sidewalks (C)
subject: rider

required_observations.note: the person riding or using it
code nonmotorized_prohibited — signs at the entrances or displayed prominently
where the signs are placed, which bounds the property
the paths of the public property

activation_conditions: signs prohibiting such devices are erected at the entrances to, or displayed prominently on, the public property
the subject rides or uses a device there

timing_requirements.requirement: judged at every instant on the posted property

residue: the extent of 'the property' comes from where the signs are posted; public ownership itself is a map assumption

title: Operation of vehicle within one hundred feet of an ice cream truck (A)
subject: driver

required_observations.note: the engaged safety equipment the cited provision describes
the speed, judged as prudent or not
the surrogate for prudence with children about

activation_conditions: an ice cream truck has engaged the safety equipment the cited provision describes
the subject is within 100 feet of it
children are present in the area

timing_requirements.requirement: judged at every instant inside the 100-foot zone while children are present

residue: tier S: 'greater than is prudent' is the whole standard; the bound is a surrogate
the truck's safety equipment is defined in a provision rendered as a definition, not a corpus line

title: Operation of vehicle within one hundred feet of an ice cream truck (B)
subject: driver

required_observations.note: the subject's position relative to the truck
the zone is all round the truck

activation_conditions: an ice cream truck has engaged the described safety equipment
the subject operates a vehicle within 100 feet of it

timing_requirements.requirement: 'in any event' — the 15 mph cap binds at every instant inside the zone, with or without children present
a single frame above 15 mph inside the zone is the violation, subject to a declared tolerance

title: Railroad crossing-control conformance
subject: pedestrian

required_observations.note: gate ∈ {down, lowering, raising} — closed, being opened or being closed
or the bridge with a barrier
the pedestrian at the gate line
the path through, around, over or under the gate

activation_conditions: a crossing gate or barrier at a railroad grade crossing or bridge is closed, being opened or being closed
the subject passes through, around, over or under it

timing_requirements.requirement: the violation is the passage of the gate line in any of those three gate states
the gate state must be tracked: passing after it is fully up is not this offence
